thread:
Taylor (sales-eng): POC kickoff with HarborTrust tomorrow. Request: SSO-only workspace, SCIM sync, ephemeral CI account, and billing visibility split from inference ops. Can we provision with least-privilege?
Ravi (infra): Yes. We can create a workspace that disables static keys and only allows ephemeral token minting. SCIM groups map to roles; include `scim_group` in the invite payload.
Maya (security): Recommend role set: `svc-inference` (mint ephemeral tokens + call inference), `billing-view` (billing data), `viewer` (read-only). Only POC owner gets `workspace-admin`. Also suggest IP allowlist for minting and disable model uploads unless explicitly requested.
Lena (acct exec): For Dedicated trial: offer a short 7-14 day reserved pool with prorated commit. If they keep low concurrency, hosted credits may be cheaper. Ask for QPS and avg token length.
Taylor (sales-eng): Customer asked for an invite JSON to automate invites. Can someone paste a minimal example?
Ravi (infra): Minimal SCIM-friendly invite payload below (they can POST it):
```json
{
  "email": "ci@harbortrust.com",
  "display_name": "Harbor POC CI",
  "roles": ["svc-inference"],
  "scim_group": "harbor-poc",
  "expires_at": "2026-11-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```
Maya (security): We'll attach a short questionnaire reply: SAML metadata, required `groups` claim for mapping, encrypted assertions, optional IP ranges for token minting, and KMS recommendation if they plan to use customer data.
onboard-bot: Onboarding link created: https://console.redwood.ai/onboard/harbortrust (expires in 6 days) :link:
Taylor (sales-eng): Action items: Ravi - post SCIM endpoint docs and ephemeral token CLI; Maya - draft security reply; Lena - price note for short Dedicated trial. I'll send the invite template to their infra team now.
